The '''Claatuvac Guild''' was an organization of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] cartographers, [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and [[Navigator/Legends|navigators]] based out of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Over the centuries, they had mapped and gathered information on a number of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]] known only to them. The Guild maintained a base in [[Tree Vikkilynn/Legends|Tree Vikkilynn]] in Kachirho; a sealed vault contained the guild's navigation data center, powered independently by a generator. The vault included data input and analysis stations as well as data stacks with information stored in indigenous manufactured [[HoloGrid/Legends|HoloGrids]].<ref name="CL" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], rumors of the Wookiees' knowledge of secret hyperroutes drew the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|attack Kashyyyk]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] in an effort to claim the data. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] counterattacked to protect the Guild's information, but the Guild chose to dissolve itself rather than hand over their data to the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Claatuvac data was distributed to the Guild's most trusted scouts who went into hiding as the Empire [[Enslavement of Kashyyyk|subjugated Kashyyyk]], and it was not until the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], nearly twenty years later, that a legitimate source of Claatuvac data came to light in the hands of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==History==
===Early history===
The Claatuvac Guild was responsible for discovering the other bodies of the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]], including [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] returned to the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]. After Wookiee navigational prowess became known, the Claatuvac routes became the stuff of legend. Most [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] operating in the Mytaranor sector claimed to know of at least one secret Wookiee route in the region, with rumors telling of hundreds more that the Claatuvacs were honor-bound to guard with their lives.<ref name="Atlas" />

===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|The Wookiees were rumored to know all sorts of secret routes – you wouldn't think it to look at them, but they're pretty fair hyperspace scouts. The Seps wanted them – and from what I heard so did our black-ops guys.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gett]], [[41st Stormtrooper Legion]], [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-9-battlfields-of-the-clone-wars|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 9: Battlefields of the Clone Wars}}</ref>}}
By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Gumbaeki]] was the Master of the Guild, with [[Chak (Wookiee)|Chak]] as an apprentice. Throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], both the Republic and CIS repeatedly sent operatives to Kashyyyk and battle fleets to the region, reasoning that knowledge of the Guild's secret routes could provide a decisive advantage.<ref name="Atlas" />

In the final weeks of the Clone Wars, [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces launched an assault on Kachirho in order to capture the Claatuvac archives and discover information on previously unknown hyperspace routes. The routes would provide a great advantage to the Confederacy of Independent Systems, especially the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], in their quest for control of galactic trade.<ref name="CL" />

The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] led by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] counterattacked to drive the Separatists from Kashyyyk. However, after witnessing [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers']] execution of their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] officers, Gumbaeki grasped the nature of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that had just been [[Declaration of a New Order|proclaimed]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Reasoning that the Empire would burn Kashyyyk to claim the Guild's secrets, Gumbaeki chose to hide the Guild's data.<ref name="Atlas" />

Gumbaeki downloaded the contents of the Guild's data stacks on to miniature encrypted [[HoloGrid/Legends|HoloGrids]], which were then distributed among the Guild's most loyal and trusted scouts and navigators, perhaps a dozen Wookiees in all. Gumbaeki then destroyed the data held in the vault in [[Tree Vikkilynn/Legends|Tree Vikkilynn]] and made himself conspicuous in Kachirho's defense, giving the rest of the Guild time to escape. When the Empire entered the Claatuvac vault they found the data stacks wiped clean and their contents irrecoverable.<ref name="Atlas" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|When we went down to take a look at the Wookiee guild vaults, we found no trace of the navigational data that had brought the Separatists to Kashyyyk in the first place.|Gett|<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut" />}}
Kashyyyk was [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|subjugated]] by the Empire shortly afterwards, and the Claatuvac stacks became the stuff of legend once again. Both [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial]] and [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Rebel intelligence]] agents pursued rumors of Claatuvac data during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], but it was not until [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] that a legitimate stack came to light: [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], first mate to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], had been entrusted with a HoloGrid, and he shared this information with Solo, allowing the pair to become accomplished smugglers. In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Chewbacca gave his stack to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] put the information to great use in its battle against the Empire.<ref name="Atlas" />
